# Restrained [Condition]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Conditions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#RestrainedCondition)*

While you have the Restrained condition, you experience the following effects.

***Speed 0.*** Your [Speed](../Movement/Speed.md) is 0 and can't increase.

***Attacks Affected.*** Attack rolls against you have [Advantage](../D20-Tests/Advantage.md), and your attack rolls have [Disadvantage](../D20-Tests/Disadvantage.md).

***Saving Throws Affected.*** You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
